Parents who choose Millicent usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In early Christian church, Millicent was associated with virtues such as courage and resilience, reflecting the name's origins in the Latin word 'militare', meaning 'to serve as a soldier'.
